subject: ProbeAI test-suite exchange + MAP and access constraints
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@probeai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25 14:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Sharing a small probe/test-suite for evaluation

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Our ML evaluation lead pulled together a compact test-suite (about 1200 examples, mixed task types) that we'd like Redwood to run in a short proof-of-efficacy check. Before we transfer, two asks from our side:

1) A mutual action plan with milestones (ingest, dry-run, initial metrics, close) and a firm timeline.
2) Clear usage guardrails: we cannot allow the assets to be used for model training or redistributed; sandboxed evaluation only.

Attaching a ZIP with a README and a small sample. We can sign your standard evaluation NDA — happy to route procurement for a brief SOW if helpful.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will accept the package and the expected turnaround?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Research, ProbeAI Labs

Attachment: probe-test-suite_v1.zip (zip, 18MB; contains README.md, examples.csv)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@probeai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25 18:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Sharing a small probe/test-suite for evaluation

Elena —

Appreciate the sample. We can accept the probe under a short MAP and the following constraints:

Summary MAP (draft):
- Day 0 (Oct 26): Redwood confirms receipt; legal accepts mutual NDA (if not already signed).
- Day 1–2: Ingest into isolated evaluation sandbox (access limited to two Redwood engineers + one SE).
- Day 3: Dry-run: run 100 example subset to validate parsing and metrics.
- Day 5: Full run and first-pass metrics report (accuracy/coverage/latency).
- Day 8: Review call to sync on results and next steps (canary, extended benchmark).

Hard usage constraints we require you confirm in writing (we will include in the MAP PDF):
- Assets are provided for evaluation only; no training/fine-tuning on Redwood systems.
- No redistribution outside Redwood evaluation team.
- Retention: Redwood will securely delete raw dataset 30 days after the last evaluation-run unless an extension is mutually agreed.
- Outputs: model outputs may be shared in aggregated form; raw outputs that contain dataset excerpts will be watermarked and subject to your approval before distribution.

I'll attach a MAP_proposal_20261025.pdf with the timeline and our checklist. Vanessa will coordinate the SSO and sandbox credentials once procurement completes. Karthik — can you confirm resource availability (2 engineers) for the Oct 26–Nov 2 window?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_proposal_20261025.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-26 09:18:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Sharing a small probe/test-suite for evaluation (internal)

Markus/Vanessa —

Available: I can allocate Akash and Mei for the ingest + metric run (they have bandwidth Oct 26–30). Proposed quick checklist:
- Pre-ingest: checksum + anti-malware scan, confirm schema mapping.
- Ingest: isolated GCP project, VPC-restricted VM, no egress.
- Dry-run: run sample 100, compare to ProbeAI 'gold' labels.
- Report: generate one-pager with per-task F1/latency, and a short failure-mode list.

On retention: 30 days is fine; recommend we add an automated deletion job (confirmed by infra). I’ll schedule the engineers and send calendar invites.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer

P.S. We should not enable any logging that could seed downstream training data — confirm logs are ephemeral and stored only for debugging window (14 days).

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@probeai.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProbeAI Procurement <procurement@probeai.com>
Date: 2026-10-27 08:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Sharing a small probe/test-suite for evaluation

Thanks — this aligns with our security team expectations. A couple clarifications before we sign:

- Please explicitly state "no training/fine-tuning" in the agreement and the automatic deletion date.
- Can you confirm the watermarked-outputs approach? We would like redactions rather than full excerpts when examples include PII.
- Procurement will push a short SOW for the sandboxing effort; please expect a DocuSign from us.

We signed and attached our NDA (ProbeAI_NDA_signed.pdf). Once the DocuSign link is live we’ll route the SOW.

Elena

Attachment: ProbeAI_NDA_signed.pdf (pdf, 40KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@probeai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29 17:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Sharing a small probe/test-suite for evaluation — MAP signed and next steps

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turn. Procurement/Legal confirmed the short MAP and the explicit "no training/fine-tuning" clause — I uploaded the signed MAP to the shared Drive (link below) and routed the SOW to procurement. DocuSign completed on our side; I see a completed envelope from docsign+probeai@example-docusign.com.

Action items we will take immediately:
- Vanessa to provision the sandbox credentials and send to your secured mailbox by Oct 30 morning.
- Karthik to run pre-ingest checks Oct 30 and ingest Oct 31.
- Deliverables: initial metrics PDF (by Nov 3) and a follow-up review call (Nov 4 at 16:00 US/PST) — meeting invite to follow.

Closing notes on usage: Redwood affirms no model training, no redistribution, 30-day auto-deletion (automation ticket: INF-7681). For any additional retention/access we will return to you with a formal amendment to the MAP.

Thanks — excited to run this through.

— Markus

Shared MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3ProbeAI-eval
